headline: Framing began on the building, six weeks ahead of schedule, and the district office will leave its lease by July 1, 2027.
summary: All exterior walls should be up by the end of the week, and Re-Arch will then set up the walls, which requires power from the town offices. Only two bills have come in so far: $30K from TF Moran and $1,600 from Miller for testing, with structure testing still to come. Brick mason supply from the northeast is an unknown, and the minutes of the July 14, 2026 meeting were approved 9-0-1.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the July 14, 2026 meeting, 9-0-1.

School District Offices Workgroup Agenda 
Meeting #12 Wed August 19th 2026, Merril Conference Room 8 AM 
1. Roll Call 
Members Present: Dan Black, Amity Small, Bob Slater, Jay Parent, Shaun 
Mulholland, Tim Porter, James Danis, and Jeremy Spaulding. Paul Marinace & 
Re-Arch Reps also present.
2. Approval of Minutes of July 14, 2026, Meeting 
Motion: Bob, 2nd: Tim. 9 0 1.
3. Progress Check In 
Building began Tues, Aug 18th with framing walls. By the end of this week 
all exterior walls will be up. Re-Arch will then set up walls. They need 
access in the town offices for power. We are six weeks ahead of schedule. 
Brick masons in the northeast being relied upon to deliver the product and 
work. That is an unknown at this point. 
4. Timelines & DO Breaking Current Lease 
District Office has broken its lease and will be officially out by July 1st, 2027
5. Re-Arch Items 
Putting together a micro-schedule in anticipation of the solar project.
